mask_roms.source: tools/fetch-rom-elfs.sh roms (espressif/esp-rom-elfs, pinned by SHA-256 in the script)

firmware.build: arduino-cli 1.5.1, Arduino-ESP32 core 3.3.12 (ESP-IDF v5.5.5); the core's WiFi and HTTPClient libraries
firmware.fqbn: esp32:esp32:esp32s3 (default options: 4 MB quad flash, DIO)

bootloader.bin.note: the core's default S3 bootloader, 4 MB flash header

firmware.not_committed: A plain Arduino build of the sketch; not added to the repository.

runs.wifi-net: esp32sim --rom roms/esp32s3_rev0_rom.elf --boot rom --board none --flash-mb 4 --bootloader bootloader.bin --ptable partitions.bin --app wifi-net.bin --wifi ssid=esp32sim --net nat --console uart0 --debug net --max-seconds 40 --no-dump
runs.resolver: etc/resolv.conf with `nameserver 8.8.8.8` under the run's current drive (a subst-mapped directory); UDP to the 1.1.1.1 fallback is blocked on this host
runs.note: The same command on main 2e36224d and on this branch, twice each (main, branch, branch, main), on a desktop with internet access: the NAT relays the guest's DNS, SNTP and HTTP to the real network through StdTransport. Host addresses and ports in the NAT log are left out of the receipt.
